gaps.sentence: I've mixed ___ the twins' names again.
gaps.explanation: mix up = confuse one thing/person with another.

gaps.sentence: An accident held ___ the traffic for two hours.
The strike brought ___ major changes in the law.
We found ___ that the flight had been cancelled.
A sales rep will follow ___ your enquiry next week.
gaps.explanation: follow up = take further action after something.

gaps.sentence: Please hand ___ your essays by Friday.
gaps.hint: give to a person in authority
gaps.explanation: hand in = give work/documents to somebody in authority.

gaps.sentence: The negotiators refused to give ___ to the hijackers' demands.
gaps.explanation: give in (to) = stop arguing and accept; give up = quit.

gaps.sentence: We saw our guests ___ at the station.
gaps.explanation: see somebody off = go with a traveller to say goodbye.
